You are grading an AI assistant's answer to a question about a company handbook.

Question: What steps should a GitLab employee take to arrange a 50% capacity return after parental leave?
Reference answer (written from the handbook): They should discuss the plan with their manager before starting leave or a few weeks before returning, and together decide on a schedule that suits both parties.

Passages the assistant was given:
"""
[Leave Types > GitLab Parental Leave > Eligibility, Entitlement and Planning Your Leave > Returning to Work at 50% Capacity]
Returning to work after parental leave can be challenging as you balance new family responsibilities while reintegrating into a workplace that has evolved during your absence.

To support this transition, GitLab offers team members the option to return at 50% capacity. This program is not tracked in Workday and does not require the Absence Management team’s review or approval. To utilize this benefit:

- Discuss with your manager before starting leave or a few weeks prior to returning
- Work together to determine a schedule that works for both you and your team
- The standard guideline is two to four weeks at reduced capacity, though this can be adjusted based on individual needs
- The 50% figure is flexible, and doesn’t always have to equate to working hours. Some options to consider would be:
  - Adjusting the workload so you’re slowly ramping back up to a full plate - this won’t look the same for everyone - some team members may prefer to ramp up more quickly
  - Adjust the working days/hours so instead of working 5-8hrs days it could be 4-10hrs, or you work really early in the morning/late in the evening
  - Slowly increase the number of working days each week (i.e. 2 days the first week, 3 days the second, etc.)

This transition period gives you space to adjust to your new normal without the pressure of a full workload, allowing time to resolve any unexpected childcare challenges or other family adjustments.

[Leave of Absence Toolkit for Team Members and Managers > Team Member Toolkit > Pre-Leave]
We recognize that the nature of the leave will impact the amount of notice a team member may be able to provide (i.e. more planning and advanced notice will be given for parental leaves vs. a medical leave which could arise unexpectedly). When possible, team members should:

- Prepare a coverage plan with their managers and fellow team members.
- Set an out of office message in Gmail and identify someone to contact during their absence. Slack and Gcal will also need to be updated to reflect the absence.
- Parental Leave:
  - Consider support from [Parentaly](https://www.parentaly.com/join/coaching-program/gitlab) to help you build a strong coverage plan, transition your work effectively and return to work with confidence after leave. You can read more about this benefit and how to sign-up in the [Parental Leave Support (Parentaly)](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave-support-parentaly) handbook section.
  - Watch the videos below from Parentaly:
  - [Creating a strong career vision through parental leave](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HlmubbY64QU)
  - [When to start the coverage planning process](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dpdh-QLlz_4)
  - [Why it’s hard for employees to return to work after parental leave](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h8vLKiMPBV8)

[Leave Types > GitLab Parental Leave > Eligibility, Entitlement and Planning Your Leave > Returning to Work]
It’s important to acknowledge that returning to work after Parental Leave can be difficult. Even with smooth reentries, life and work interplay differently when one adds another member to their family. Everyone transitions differently, and the impact on an individual varies depending on role, as well as a litany of personal factors.

About a week before your expected return, the Absence Management team will send you a welcome back email which will share resources and ask you to confirm your return to work date. **Please respond by confirming the date you will return.**

More Return-to-work Resources shared [here](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave).

[GitLab Inc (US) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security: Security You Can Count On > Disability Protection]
1. The Absence Management team will guide you through the application process. This will include:
   a. Providing you with filing options (online portal, phone, or paper)
   b. Providing NYLife with the employer eligibility intake information
   c. Sending you the Assignment of Benefits form

2. After 26 weeks (maximum benefit period), you'll need to determine if you can return to work

**Returning to work:** Email leaves@gitlab.com a physician's Return to Work authorization at least 5 calendar days before your planned return date. Include any needed accommodations.

**If you can't return after 26 weeks:** You'll move to unpaid leave with the option to continue benefits through COBRA. You can also apply for long-term disability at this time.

NYLife Claim Process for Short-Term Disability

**Step 1: Submit Your [Short-Term Disability](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1guydUTEc0vBFMaa_IsSktZ5hXAbOXdvD/view?usp=sharing) Application.** Complete the claimant portion and have your physician finish the rest. You can either:

- Send directly to NYLife (using the mail/fax number on the form), or
- Return to leaves@gitlab.com who will submit it for you

Let the Absence Management team know which option you choose.

**Step 2: NYLife Review Process**

[GitLab GK (Japan) Benefits > Health & Wellbeing Benefits > Family & Life Transition Support]
Maternity Leave & Benefits

**Overview**

Take 14 weeks of protected maternity leave with two-thirds of your base salary through government allowance.

**Eligibility**

- All pregnant GitLab GK team members
- Available regardless of employment length

**Key Features**

Leave starts 6 weeks before due date. Government provides 2/3 salary during entire leave period.

**How to Access**

1. **Plan**: Leave begins 6 weeks before delivery
2. **Apply**: Submit government allowance application
3. **Coordinate**: Work with manager and People Operations

**Important Information**

- May coordinate with [GitLab Parental Leave](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/) if eligible

Parental Leave (Child Care Leave)

**Overview**

Take up to one year of protected leave with substantial government financial support.

**Eligibility**

- Available until child's first birthday
- Fixed-term employees need one year employment
- Must commit to return to work

**Key Features**

Receive 67% salary (first 6 months), 50% thereafter. Both parents can take leave.

**How to Access**

1. **Plan**: Starts after maternity leave (mothers) or from birth (fathers)
2. **Apply**: Submit allowance application
3. **Coordinate**: Arrange role coverage

**Important Information**

- May coordinate with [GitLab Parental Leave](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/) if eligible

Additional Family Support

**Child Nursing Care Leave**: Up to 5 days (1 child) or 10 days (2+ children). Runs with GitLab PTO.

[Remote.com > **Clear benefits, real support** > **Italy 🇮🇹**]
If eligible, a team member's first 16 weeks of leave will be supplemented the remaining 20% per GitLab's [Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave). GitLab's Parental leave will run concurrently with any statutory leave and/or pay entitlements the team member is eligible for.

**Applying for Maternity Leave in Italy**

To initiate your parental leave, submit your time off by selecting the Parental Leave category in Workday at least 30 days before your leave starts. Please familiarize yourself with [GitLab's Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave).

**Paternity Leave**

Below is the information related to Italy's statutory leave policies. Please note that team members hired in Italy are hired via Remote (PEO) and you should always check with Remote first for the most up to date information.

Fathers are also obligated to take a seven-day paid leave of absence from work during the five months of maternity leave. The mother has the option to extend the father's paternal leave if she transfers one of her maternity days to him.

If eligible, team members can take up to 16 weeks of time away (in total) per GitLab's [Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave). GitLab's Parental leave will run concurrently with any statutory leave and/or pay entitlements the team member is eligible for.
"""

Assistant's answer:
"""
To arrange a 50% capacity return, an employee should discuss the plan with their manager before starting leave or a few weeks prior to returning [1]. They must then work together to determine a schedule that works for both the employee and the team, typically lasting two to four weeks [1]. This program does not require review or approval from the Absence Management team [1].
"""

First write one sentence of reasoning, then grade three things:
- correctness: "correct" if the answer states the key information in the reference answer without contradicting it (extra correct detail is fine); "partial" if it gets part of it or is vague; "incorrect" if it is wrong, contradicts the reference, or does not answer.
- refused: true if the assistant declined or said it does not know, instead of answering.
- faithful: true if every factual claim in the answer is supported by the passages above (ignore whether it matches the reference). An answer that only refuses counts as faithful.
The grades must agree with your reasoning.
Return JSON with the reasoning first: {"reason": "one sentence", "correctness": "correct" | "partial" | "incorrect", "refused": true/false, "faithful": true/false}
